info.title: Cisco Support
info.description: Cisco Support APIs providing programmatic access to bug, case, end-of-life, product information, serial number, software suggestion, software download, and RMA data from the Cisco Support portal.
info.x-itential-curated: Reviewed against the repo's common-CRUD-for-automation policy: all 40 upstream operations (Bug, Case, EoX, Product Information, Serial Number to Information, Software Suggestion, Automated Software Distribution, Service Order Return) are already in scope, so the full spec is carried through as -latest. See the repo README for the operation breakdown and the full spec.
